note: Reused proven CSI-VERIFY-001 firmware/configuration — no modification in Phase B unless separate Gate 3 (§5.1, §11)

app_main.wifi_csi: lltf_en true ltf_merge_en true channel_filter_en true

sdkconfig.defaults: CONFIG_IDF_TARGET="esp32" + sdkconfig.defaults (921600, CSI_ENABLED) + CONFIG_EXAMPLE_WIFI_SSID="Nihaal" + CONFIG_EXAMPLE_WIFI_PASSWORD="REDACTED" + CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHSIZE_4MB=y

build.command: source /tmp/esp-idf-v5.4/export.sh; cd /tmp/csi_recv_router && rm -rf build && idf.py build

flash.command: sudo chmod 666 /dev/ttyUSB0; sudo -u ubuntu bash -c 'source /tmp/esp-idf-v5.4/export.sh; cd /tmp/csi_recv_router; idf.py -p /dev/ttyUSB0 -b 460800 flash'
flash.chip: ESP32-D0WD-V3 revision v3.1 MAC f4:65:0b:56:0e:18 Crystal 40MHz
flash.result: Compressed 26048->16425 @0x1000, 740144->496832 @0x10000, 3072->103 @0x8000 Hash verified Hard resetting via RTS Done EXIT 0
flash.note: NO erase_flash, only targeted write_flash to external SPI flash; volatile /tmp tools lost on reboot but ESP32 flash retains firmware

capture.method: pyserial Serial('/dev/ttyUSB0',921600, timeout=1) read(4096) -> wb no parsing

firmware_change_policy: If ever needed: separate approval Gate 3 with justification + pinned SHAs + firmware_change.json — never automatic; not planned
